Renders the inverted result through a print stock's response; contrast and colour come from that stock. It runs after inversion and before frame editing.

Six Rec709 Film Looks from Resolve are bundled. Any .cube timelined on Cineon Film Log also works; declare its output encoding under 「输出」 beside this picker. Drop .cube files into the LUT folder (Help → Open LUT folder) to add several at once.

"Standard" applies no print look. A roll parameter, saved with the project.

Declares this LUT's output encoding. A .cube carries no colour space of its own; the bundled stocks state theirs, so this does not appear for them. Enter the output space the LUT was generated in: Rec.709 Gamma 2.4, DCI-P3 Gamma 2.6, sRGB, or Rec.2100 ST2084 (HDR only).

The input is always Cineon Film Log. A wrong declaration does not raise an error — it produces wrong colour. Saved with the project.
HDR 下印片决定颜色（色相、饱和度、高光去饱和），影调由解析肩部铺到 HDR:
Under HDR the print stock sets the colour (hue, saturation, highlight desaturation) while the tone is carried to the HDR limit by the analytic shoulder, identical to the stock below the knee. Thumbnails, contact sheets and the gain-map base use that stock's SDR rendition.

A LUT declared as PQ output gives way to the standard display render under SDR and returns when HDR is on.
Cineon 第 4 步的目标空间：反相结果转换到它，帧编辑在它内进行，导出也写: The target space of Cineon's step 4: the inverted result is converted into it, frame editing happens in it, and exports are written in it. The working space is ACEScg, so every option here is a real gamut conversion. Switching keeps the slider values and moves the picture with them. A roll parameter, saved with the project.
HDR 渲染不裁到任何色域三角，P3 与 Adobe RGB 之外的颜色原样保留: An HDR render is clipped to no gamut triangle: colour outside P3 and Adobe RGB is kept as it is, and a float32 TIFF export keeps it too. Container primaries (P3 / BT.2020) are chosen at PQ export. How much of it reaches the screen is the display's business — see the colour status at bottom left.
每个通道读作黑的密度（相对完全透光 T=1）。C-41 橙色片基必然 R&lt;: The density each channel reads as black, against full transmission T=1. A C-41 orange mask is necessarily R<G<B, typically 0.09 / 0.29 / 0.54. Expand the three components to adjust the shadow cast.
解这一卷的色偏——胶片、扫描与片基留在两端上的偏差。灰卡是测量，智能色偏修正是推: Solves this roll's cast — what the film, the scanner and the base leave on the two endpoints. The grey card measures it; the neural estimate guesses it. Either writes D_max's three densities, and it replaces highlight sampling: whichever ran last stands.
